summary: An easy, welcoming daily: six famous capitals are gimmes, Istanbul, Kyiv and Saint Petersburg take a second thought, and Baku is the stretch. Famous smaller cities like Barcelona cost lives, and Blitz is deep.
reasons: Casual found 8 (London, Paris, Berlin, Madrid, Rome, Moscow, Istanbul, Kyiv) and ran out of lives on Barcelona #15, Amsterdam, Vienna #11, Milan #23 and Munich #19 before trying Saint Petersburg. Fan found 9, losing every life on #11-#16 before trying Baku. Estimated par 7: the easy edge of the target.

Misses teach the city-limits rule ('Barcelona is #15, 1,731,649. So close.'). Baku counts as Europe by one convention (the source footnotes it), so expect argument. Paris (#10, a 1 Jan 2025 figure) leads Vienna (1 Jul 2026) by 7,186; rejudge if a refresh swaps them.
Blitz is deep: 24 of 26 casual names scored. Non-EU cities under 1M score 0 or go unrecognized (Manchester, Leeds, Glasgow, Oslo), which UK players will notice.
fixes: Non-EU European cities between 300k and 1M lack a population or are missing: Manchester, Edinburgh, Oslo and Zürich are accepted but score 0 in Blitz; Glasgow, Liverpool, Sheffield, Bristol, Cardiff, Belfast, Lviv, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia and Saratov are not recognized at all. Add a source with their city-limits population (EU cities down to Augsburg, 301,105, already score).

'leeds' is offered as Lee's Summit and 'almaty' as Albany (a life if confirmed in classic, auto-corrected to those names in Blitz). Adding Leeds and Almaty to the pool removes both; the matcher arguably should not make those offers at all (src/game/match.ts).

Junk aliases, harmless in play: Berlin 'CityBerlin', 'Berlin.de', 'Silicon Allee'; Paris 'Paris.fr', 'Paris, Banks of the Seine'; London 'Londonise', 'Londonize'; Saint Petersburg 'Four bridges on three lines', 'Four bridges on three support', 'Cahkt-Netep6ypr'; Kyiv 'Kiyeff Kiev'; Rome 'Gente di roma', 'Rome, Republic and Empire'.
